title: Amazon launches the Echo Show 16, Echo Time, Alexa Photo Frame, and new Echo speakers
description: Amazon has refreshed its Alexa hardware lineup with five new devices: the redesigned Echo Show 16 smart display, a new Echo Dot, the Echo Studio with Home Camera, the Echo Time smart clock, and the Alexa Photo Frame. All of them come with the latest version of Alexa+, which the company says can now hold more natural conversations, ask clarifying questions, and handle complex multi-step requests. As a reminder, Alexa+ is free for Prime members. Compared to the Echo Show 15, the Echo Show 16 has a 16-inch Full HD screen with 10% more viewing area, set in an anodized aluminum frame that's...

title: The Samsung W27 goes official in China
description: Samsung has unveiled the W27, its latest W-series foldable smartphone, in China. The handset is essentially a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra with a luxury makeover, featuring gold accents and a more premium finish. The Samsung W27 sports a dual-tone design in red and blue, colors traditionally associated with Chinese culture. The gold finish extends to the frame, hinge, rear camera module, and camera lens rings. The rear panel also features the signature gold ‘Heart to the World’ logo. Both the front and rear panels are protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3. Samsung is also bundling...

title: Honor X9e s launched
description: Honor’s latest addition to its X-series is now official with the Honor X9e s. The device is already available across the Middle East with a starting price of SAR 1,499 ($400) for the single 8/256GB trim. It may look familiar, and there’s good reason why: the X9e s is a rebadged Honor Turbo, which came out back in August. Honor X9e s The X9e s comes in the same Dawn Orange, Midnight Black and Glacier White colors. It’s built around a 6.79 AMOLED screen with FHD+ resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate and 1,800 nits peak brightness. You also get Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chip with 8GB...

title: Apple reportedly lowered its iPhone Duo QA standards to get more units out in time
description: There has been no shortage of controversy surrounding the iPhone Duo and more specifically its delicate hinge mechanism. We’ve seen numerous reports of inner display damage with Apple openly acknowledging the issue, claiming it only affects “a small number of iPhone Duo units” and that affected users should contact Apple for a replacement. Image source: Vishnu_RK (Reddit) But a report from Chinese outlet Jiemian News suggests Apple had “lowered its quality inspection standards” to get more Duo units out to retailers ahead of the holiday period. The information was disclosed by an...

title: New certification corroborates Samsung Galaxy S27's charging speed
description: The Samsung Galaxy S7, bearing model code SM-S9520, bagged 3C certification last month, which revealed it will support 25W charging speed. Now, multiple Samsung devices, believed to be the Galaxy S27, have been certified by Denmark's UL Solutions (Demko), corroborating the charging speed. Samsung Galaxy S27's leaked render (Source: OnLeaks and Android Headlines) The certificates for all models list ratings of 9V DC and 2.77A, which is 24.93W, meaning the devices will be advertised as supporting 25W charging. That's the same wired charging speed as the Galaxy S26 announced in...

title: Wobble to launch its second smartphone, the Speed 5G
description: Wobble, an Indian smartphone brand owned by Indkal Technologies, is preparing to launch its second handset, the Speed 5G. The company debuted its first smartphone, the Wobble One, in November last year. The company has shared a couple of teasers on social media, confirming the upcoming phone’s launch in India and offering a glimpse of its rear design. Based on the teaser images, the Wobble Speed 5G will feature a circular rear camera module, replacing the square-shaped setup on the Wobble One. The upcoming smartphone is expected to be priced under INR 20,000 and is likely to...

title: Here's when the iQOO 16 is rumored to launch outside China
description: The iQOO 16 went official in China back in late September, and earlier this month we heard that it's headed to India too. Today, a tipster on X claims to know exactly when that will happen. According to him, the iQOO 16 will launch in India around December 15-17. If that's right, Indian fans will have to wait quite a bit longer than last year. The iQOO 15 was announced in China on October 20, 2025, and its international rollout started with India on November 26, a little over five weeks later. This time around, the gap would be closer to two and a half months. The big question...

title: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max go on sale in India
description: The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max, launched in India last week, go on sale today via Oppo's Indian website, Amazon.in, Flipkart, and mainline retail outlets. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max comes in Luna White and Titanium Grey in a single 12GB/512GB configuration, priced at INR199,999. Oppo Find X10 Pro Max's color options The Oppo Find X10, on the other hand, has three color options - Glacier Blue, Mist Grey, and Glow Coral. It comes in two memory configurations - 12GB/256GB and 12GB/512GB, priced at INR139,999 and INR169,999, respectively. Oppo Find X10's color...

title: iQOO Pad Pro brings the Ultra's 165Hz screen and big battery for less
description: iQOO teased a more affordable sibling for its compact gaming tablet earlier this month, and today the iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 became official in China. It launched alongside the iQOO Neo12 and keeps most of what makes the iQOO Pad Ultra interesting, including an active cooling fan, but with a different chipset. The iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 comes with an 8.8-inch 2304x1440 AMOLED screen with a 165Hz refresh rate (in supported games), 1,600-nit full-screen and 4,500-nit peak local brightness, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset paired with iQOO's own Q3 gaming chip, up to 16GB of LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and...

title: Huawei's Starlight brand to debut with a wide-screen phone, leak claims
description: Earlier this month, a report claimed that Huawei was preparing to launch a new sub-brand called Xingmang, which translates to “Starlight” in Chinese. Now, a tipster has shared details about the first smartphone from the upcoming brand. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the first smartphone from Huawei’s upcoming sub-brand will feature a wide-screen candybar design. The handset is tipped to sport a 6.39-inch display and be powered by a Kirin 9000-series chipset. The top-end variant is said to offer up to 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage. The tipster also claims that the...

title: The new Redmi Clip Neo buds cost half as much as the Xiaomi Clip-on
description: Xiaomi’s first clip-on style buds, suitably named the Xiaomi Clip-on, were unveiled back in May alongside the Xiaomi 17 Max launch. Today, the company is introducing the Redmi K100 and the Redmi Clip Neo buds appeared alongside. This style of buds clips around your ear instead of relying on friction to stay in your ear. The Clip Neo in particular relies on 0.6mm flexible memory titanium wire to give them some springiness – this has survived 25,000 bending tests. Skin-friendly silicone is used on the “inside” parts that touch your ear for long-term comfort. Each bud only weighs...

title: Honor X8e 4G quietly launches with a 108MP camera and a 7,700mAh battery
description: Is it true that you can’t have too many models? Maybe, maybe not, but here's one more – the Honor X8e 4G, a phone that is nearly identical to the Honor X7e Plus 4G from August. Honor X8e 4G The most eye-catching feature on this phone is the 108MP camera. The phone is an entry-level model that was spotted on the Honor Azerbaijan site. Local retailers sell it for AZN 820 – that’s $480, but for context, a Galaxy A08 4G is AZN 590. Plus, another retailer has the X8e at AZN 688. This is only 17% more than the A08 – and note that Honor prices are for a 6/256GB model, while the Galaxy...

title: SK hynix reports record Q3 numbers, warns that the memory shortage will last through 2030
description: SK hynix had a stellar quarter – the financial report for Q3 reports revenues of KRW 104.6 trillion. This is the first time that the quarterly sales have gone above the KRW 100 trillion mark. Better still, the company has margins that we can all be envious of – operating profit was KRW 83.3 trillion and net profit was KRW 39.8 trillion. This is an operating margin of 80% and a net margin of 38%. The company reports cash and cash equivalents of KRW 114.5 trillion at the end of Q3, up KRW 26.5 trillion compared to the previous quarter. Meanwhile, borrowings decreased to KRW 15.8 trillion,...

title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro starts receiving the update to Android 17
description: Motorola has started rolling out the update to Android 17 for the Edge 70 Pro, according to a report on Reddit. The update is currently going out to the European model, and it's a 3.42GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. Once you've installed it, your phone will be on software version A171WMH.44-25. [#InlinePriceWidget,14620,1#] The changelog says you can expect "a fresh, expressive design", reduced clutter with smarter notifications, faster multitasking with more apps being accessible at once, and extra security with "enhanced protection and controls"....

title: Samsung's sleep apnea detection gets better on the Galaxy Watches and Galaxy Ring
description: Samsung first got its Galaxy Watch sleep apnea feature approved at home in Korea back in 2023, then received De Novo authorization from the FDA in early 2024. Since then it has expanded to many more markets, and the company says it's now available in 84 countries. Today Samsung announced that an upgraded version of the feature, which got FDA approval in July, has also been approved by Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). The new version doesn't just detect signs of moderate to severe sleep apnea. It uses an AI algorithm to count the number of breathing disruptions per hour...

title: iQOO Neo12 debuts with a 9,000mAh battery, 185Hz display
description: iQOO’s latest Neo series smartphone has launched in China. The iQOO Neo12 gets an in-built active cooling fan and is equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC. The Neo12 comes with the custom 59-blade fan that is claimed to have increased airflow by around 10%. The handset also gets a large 3D Ice Dome vapor chamber for improved thermal efficiency. At the front, the phone sports a 6.83-inch AMOLED display developed by Visionox. It uses a p-TSF technology and offers a refresh rate of 185Hz and a 2K resolution with a 2,200 nit peak brightness. There’s also a dedicated display...

title: Apple announces new MacBook Pro models with OLED and touchscreen
description: Apple today announced a new series of MacBook Pro models that will sell alongside the existing range. The new models feature the long awaited OLED displays and also bring touchscreen support to the Mac for the first time. The main feature here is the display, which Apple calls PROLED XDR. The new display features the same Tandem OLED technology that we saw on the iPad Pro models, which layers two OLED panels over each other to increase their light output. The displays on the MacBook Pro are capable of up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness and 1,000 nits of sustained brightness. The...

title: Samsung's next wide foldable will reportedly get a sibling
description: Samsung launched its first wide foldable, the Galaxy Z Fold8, back in July, alongside the more traditionally shaped Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. Now a tipster from Korea claims that the wide Fold8 is selling much better than Samsung itself expected, citing sources at a display supplier. [#InlinePriceWidget,14673,1#] Because of that, Samsung will allegedly add a second model to its wide foldable lineup next year, which the tipster describes as a sure thing. What kind of model it will be hasn't been decided yet. Samsung is reportedly testing two options: one with a bigger display than the...

title: Here's when Motorola's Signature 27 is landing in India
description: Motorola announced the Signature 27 during Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit back in September. It still hasn't revealed the phone's full specs or pricing, but today we know when it's coming to India. The company has put up a dedicated page for the Signature 27 on its Indian website, which says it's "coming this November". The page confirms the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, and Motorola calls the Signature 27 its "fastest Android phone". Cooling comes from a diamond-infused thermal gel and a new 3D vapor chamber. There's a 200MP periscope telephoto camera with Super Zoom Pro,...

title: Huawei Enjoy 100 is also here with a 6.56-inch screen and a 6,100mAh battery
description: Alongside the Enjoy 100 Pro and Enjoy 100 Pro Max, Huawei has also unveiled the standard Enjoy 100 in China. The phone is powered by a Kirin 8000S chipset and features a 6.56-inch LCD display. The Huawei Enjoy 100 is now available for pre-order in China, with prices starting at CNY 1,399 for the 128GB storage variant. The 6.56-inch display supports a 90Hz refresh rate and offers a peak brightness of 1,150 nits. The handset measures 8.98mm in thickness and weighs 204 grams.
